g.text: Source: TI PCM1808, PCM510xA, OPA1656, TLV767 and TLV755P datasheets. Do not fabricate this partial design.

g.desc: Source: TI PCM1808, PCM510xA, OPA1656, TLV767 and TLV755P datasheets. Do not fabricate this partial design.

g.text: Input: approx 0.91 Mohm, bias 3.285 V at 9 V; 1:2 AC attenuation. Headroom/protection need tolerance review and bench tests.

g.desc: Input: approx 0.91 Mohm, bias 3.285 V at 9 V; 1:2 AC attenuation. Headroom/protection need tolerance review and bench tests.

g.text: C230/C235 Panasonic FK 2x1000 uF: verify inrush/pulse impedance/temp/age/load and >= 150/fs + 0.2 ms mute hold-up on hardware.

g.desc: C230/C235 Panasonic FK 2x1000 uF: verify inrush/pulse impedance/temp/age/load and >= 150/fs + 0.2 ms mute hold-up on hardware.

g.text: AUDIO_ENABLE must be driven HIGH only after FPGA clocks/data are stable. CT open: 20 ms release delay; default enable LOW.

g.desc: AUDIO_ENABLE must be driven HIGH only after FPGA clocks/data are stable. CT open: 20 ms release delay; default enable LOW.

g.text: KESTREL REV B - HARDWARE-CONFIGURED ADC/DAC - ENGINEERING DRAFT

g.desc: KESTREL REV B - HARDWARE-CONFIGURED ADC/DAC - ENGINEERING DRAFT

g.text: No audio I2C. Mono left channel. Protection and supervisor mute included; layout, rail hold-up and backend validation pending.

g.desc: No audio I2C. Mono left channel. Protection and supervisor mute included; layout, rail hold-up and backend validation pending.

g.text: Clock target: synchronous 48 kHz LRCLK / 3.072 MHz BCLK / 12.288 MHz ADC MCLK. Current RTL must be migrated.

g.desc: Clock target: synchronous 48 kHz LRCLK / 3.072 MHz BCLK / 12.288 MHz ADC MCLK. Current RTL must be migrated.

g.text: ADC VREF is decoupling only. VINR AC grounded. DAC charge-pump/bypass returns must be short; use one common ground plane.

g.desc: ADC VREF is decoupling only. VINR AC grounded. DAC charge-pump/bypass returns must be short; use one common ground plane.

g.text: DAC low-latency filter; supervisor AUDIO_RUN defaults muted. Protection/hold-up validation, sourcing and thermal checks remain.

g.desc: DAC low-latency filter; supervisor AUDIO_RUN defaults muted. Protection/hold-up validation, sourcing and thermal checks remain.

g.text: Place at jacks; short ground return

g.desc: Place at jacks; short ground return

g.text: DAC AVDD/CPVDD/DVDD share held 3.3 V. ADC 5 V and buck 5 V monitored; either low asserts XSMT.

g.desc: DAC AVDD/CPVDD/DVDD share held 3.3 V. ADC 5 V and buck 5 V monitored; either low asserts XSMT.

g.text: DAC HOLD-UP / SUPERVISOR MUTE - ENGINEERING DRAFT

g.desc: DAC HOLD-UP / SUPERVISOR MUTE - ENGINEERING DRAFT
